definition.title: SFU Writer’s Studio Writing Consults at Mount Pleasant Branch
definition.description:
Are you working on a writing project and need a nudge in the right direction? Sign up for a 45-minute, one-to-one manuscript consultation with a graduate of Simon Fraser University's The Writer's Studio: Creative Writing Certificate program. Submit up to seven (7) pages of your poetry, fiction prose, or non-fiction prose, and receive supportive feedback that will help guide you on your writing journey.

Your manuscript must be provided in the following form:

Title of your work(s) at the top centre

Your name beneath

Page numbers on the bottom

Double-spaced,12-point font

Word or PDF files only

Please register at least 10 days prior to the consultation time you are requesting. A representative will reach out to you via email to collect your manuscript one week before your scheduled appointment. One consult per person; previous participants are ineligible.

Presented in partnership with The Writer's Studio at Simon Fraser University.

Accessibility Information
VPL is committed to making our programs accessible for all. If you have an access need that we have not addressed here, please email us at info@vpl.ca. 

  • Takes place indoors in a small group space
  • The expected noise level is moderate
  • Sudden or loud noises may occur

For more information on physical access, view the Accessibility information on the Mount Pleasant Branch page

definition.title: Climate Solutions For Eco-Anxiety In Elementary School Children
definition.description:
Help your child turn climate worries into hope and action. This facilitated workshop for caregivers with elementary school-aged children explores the symptoms of eco-anxiety and offers practical ways to respond. Discover nature-based activities and climate solutions your family can do together while helping children build resilience and develop positive, action-focused responses to climate change and biodiversity loss.

Presenters:

Joan Sutherland MA BA retired Nurse Clinician in Child Mental Health

Aileen Stalker MA BSR OT retired Occupational Therapist BCCH Child and Family mental Health Unit and private practice in the community

Accessibility Information

VPL is committed to making our programs accessible for all. If you have an access need that we have not addressed here, please email us at info@vpl.ca.

  • Participants are welcome to move, stim, or take breaks as needed
  • Participants may leave the room at any time
  • Lighting in the room is bright and nonadjustable

For more information on physical access, view the Accessibility information on the Mount Pleasant page.

definition.title: AI for Everyday Life
definition.description:
AI is changing how we interact with technology, and it already powers many tools and services we use every day. If you are curious about the latest AI headlines but unsure what they mean for your day-to-day life, you’re in the right place. Join us for a practical, beginner-friendly workshop designed to help you navigate this technology with confidence.

Brad Frenette, CBC's AI Advisor for Sports and Entertainment, will host the workshop, which will feature activities, group discussions, and explainer videos hosted by CBC's Andrew Chang. We’ll dive into practical uses and useful tips for writing effective prompts, and discover how to safely manage these tools' real risks and limitations, including spotting deepfakes and recognizing why and how AI makes mistakes.

This program is in partnership with the CBC.

Filming Notice: This event may be recorded. By participating, you acknowledge that your image, likeness, and/or voice may be recorded by the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation (“CBC”).

Accessibility Information
VPL is committed to making our programs accessible for all. If you have an access need that we have not addressed here, please email us at info@vpl.ca.

  • Participants may leave the room at any time
  • Noise level is expected to be low to moderate
  • Takes place in a programming room with limited turnaround space

For more information on physical access, view the Accessibility information on the Central Library page.
